frequency_question: How often does the GST Council resolve structural input tax credit blockages through statutory amendments within a defined legislative cycle?
membership_rule: Includes all formal GST Council recommendations and subsequent statutory amendments addressing blocked input tax credits under Section 17(5) or equivalent restrictive provisions from 2017 to present. Excludes routine clarifications that do not alter statutory eligibility.

cases.name: First Amendment relaxing motor vehicle ITC for specific sectors
Clarification and partial relaxation on leasing and outward supply matching
Amendment on CSR expenditure input tax credit eligibility
Retrospective regularisation of past periods without refunds

coverage_note: 4 major structural restriction areas identified under the primary statute; only motor vehicle category received partial relaxation.
known_gaps: Excludes minor procedural circulars that lower compliance friction without amending the core statutory block.
skeleton: Total major structural ITC restriction categories under Section 17(5) (4 categories: motor vehicles, goods/services for personal consumption, works contract services for construction of immovable property other than plant & machinery, and goods/services on which tax has been paid under composition levy) evaluated across periodic council reviews.
multiplier: 1 successful relaxation out of 4 major structural restriction domains reviewed periodically over 4 major structural amendment cycles.
validity_reason: The GST Council framework and voting structure remain stable under the current constitutional amendment mechanism.
